integrity: The proof reduces zero coordinates of an \(r\)-subcode to intersections with a \((k-r)\)-dimensional orthogonal subspace, then uses an injective coordinate projection on that subspace to bound its face-characteristic vectors by an induced subcomplex. Coordinate subspaces attain the bound. A standalone verifier checks all full-vertex simplicial complexes through four vertices over two fields, source Example 4.2, and finite instances of the source's distance-optimal family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the characteristic-face code \(C_\Delta^*\) of the 2026 source. It does not solve the distinct \(q>2\) vector-downset simplicial-complex construction, and it determines the generalized-weight hierarchy rather than the full subcode-support distribution.
title: Induced subcomplexes determine every generalized Hamming weight of simplicial face codes
